asset.description: the item of plant the prestart is about

asset_registration_number.description: the registration number for plant that must be registered before use

certifier.description: the competent person who performed or certified the prestart

external_id.description: the source form-result's own identifier, as text

flagged_count.description: how many answers name a fault; the shelf's primary condition signal

form_title.description: the tenant's own name for the prestart form the record was captured on; the key the `form_pattern` sweep matches

hour_meter_reading.description: the machine's hour-meter reading recorded at the prestart

jurisdiction.description: the WHS/examination regime whose interval and retention rule apply

narrative_count.description: how many free-text answers were filled in

occurred_at.description: when the prestart was submitted; the date the retention clock runs from

prestart_date.description: the date the form itself carries, where it differs from submission time

project.description: the project the plant was pre-started on that day

source_system.description: which bound system emitted the row; `ASSIGNAR` today

source_units.description: the source unit each measure arrived in, beside the canonical unit

tag_severity.description: the green/yellow/red plant tag at its worst on the form

tenant_payload.description: the tenant's own prestart questions and answers — check-item results, selectors, comments, the grout/mixer numerics

unanswered_count.description: how many answerable questions were left blank

worker.description: the worker who submitted the prestart; an anchor, not a declared axis
